Title: General availability: Row-level security (RLS) for Azure SQL Data Warehouse

Body.Content:
Row-level security (RLS) for Azure SQL Data Warehouse is now generally available. RLS is a new capability that can help you manage security for sensitive data.

Securing your data assets in the cloud is critical to building trust with your customers and partners. RLS can help you implement security policies to control access to rows in your tables. RLS enables fine-grained, row-level access control without requiring a redesign of your data warehouse. Your overall security model is simplified: the access restriction logic is located in the database tier itself.

RLS supports SQL authentication and Azure Active Directory authentication.

For more information about row-level security in Azure SQL Data Warehouse, see the full blog post and our online documentation.
